title: 第23章 此子非池中之物必须得尽快斩杀第24章 带着大家一起贪谁会举报我
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“什么？！”
随着管家的话音落地。
镇北王与李夫子的脸色，皆是一变。
他们简直不敢相信，刚刚登基的神霄，竟敢破坏游戏规则，派遣锦衣卫，上门抄家。
这不等于是直接跟他们撕破脸吗？
意识到，这或许是扳倒神霄机会的镇北王，
强压下内心的激动，追问道：“神霄用什么样的理由，去抄的曹阿瞒家？”
管家神情肃穆道：“锦衣卫怀疑曹阿瞒就是刺杀上任陛下的凶手！”
噗~
听到这个理由，镇北王突然笑出了声。
一旁的李夫子更是一脸玩味道：“王爷，神霄这是被刺激的恼羞成怒了呀！”
“咱们的机会，是不是来了？”
面对李夫子似笑非笑的询问，镇北王的嘴角也掀起一抹玩味的冷笑：
“本来本王还想着用温水煮青蛙的方式，让神霄知难而退，没想到那贱婢竟然自己作死！”
“既然这样……”
镇北王缓缓抬起头，将阴冷的目光落在李夫子的身上，冷声道：
“带上你们北冥书院的学子，好好地给那贱婢上一课，让她知道朝堂斗争，意气用事可不行！”
……
一炷香后。

曹阿瞒的私人府邸内。
一名锦衣卫，一脸严肃地跑进院内，汇报道：
“启禀大人，北冥书院的李夫子，正带着数百位学生，往这边赶来！”
此话一出。
被两名锦衣卫按在地上无法动弹的曹阿瞒，不由的大笑道：
“徐大人，您现在找到我刺杀上任陛下的证据了吗？”
“要是没有，我奉劝您还是抓紧想一想，待会怎么跟我们这些读书人解释解释，您今日的栽赃行为！”
听到曹阿瞒嚣张至极的话语，徐达的脸色也是阴沉到了极点。
特别是见到沈浪还在那边不急不缓的瞎溜达时，更是气不打一处来。
直接冷着脸，走到沈浪身旁，质问道：“我说你小子，到底靠不靠谱呀？！”
“李夫子都要来了，你怎么还在这里数锦鲤？”
面对徐达的质问，一直在思索到底要不要将曹阿瞒家藏宝地给搞出来的沈浪，也是豁出去道：
“大人，卑职能问问，您跟我家娘子亦或者是上官家的关系，足够的铁吗？”
徐达眉头一挑：“你问这个干什么？”
“没什么，我就是想给我家婆娘赚点医药费，担心大人您会有意见！”沈浪憨厚的挠了挠头。
“哦？”
徐达作为两朝元老，可谓是官场上的人精。
听到沈浪这话，也是瞬间秒懂。
沈浪一直不干活，敢情不是不靠谱。
而是特么的想贪污！

说句实在话，若是以往有下属打算在抄家的时候贪污，并且还当着他的面提起这事，他肯定会将其诛杀，以儆效尤！
但现在，他已经知道，沈浪跟神霄之间的关系。
更知道，沈浪贪污，也是为了给神霄治病，自然不会拒绝。
content_en:

"What?!"
As the butler's words fell to the ground.
The expressions of King Zhenbei and Master Li changed.
They simply couldn't believe that Shen Xiao, who had just ascended the throne, dared to break the rules of the game and send Jin Yiwei to raid his home.
Doesn't this mean breaking up with them directly?
King Zhenbei realized that this might be his chance to overthrow Shenxiao.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, he asked: "What reason did Shen Xiao use to raid Cao Ahao's house?"
The butler looked solemn and said: "Jin Yiwei suspects that Cao Ah Man is the murderer who assassinated His Majesty!"
Phew~
Upon hearing this reason, King Zhenbei suddenly laughed out loud.
Master Li on the side looked even more amused: "Your Majesty, Shen Xiao is so irritated that he is so angry!"
"Has our opportunity come?"
Facing Master Li's half-smiling inquiry, King Zhenbei also had a playful sneer on his lips:
"Originally, I was thinking of boiling the frog in warm water to make Shenxiao retreat, but I didn't expect that that wretched maid would commit suicide!"
"In this case..."
King Zhenbei slowly raised his head, cast his cold eyes on Master Li, and said coldly:
"Take your students from Beiming Academy and teach that bitch a lesson. Let her know that fighting in the court based on emotion is not enough!"
…
After a stick of incense.
Inside Cao Ahao's private residence.
A guard in Jinyi ran into the courtyard with a serious face and reported:
"Master Qi, Master Li from Beiming Academy is coming here with hundreds of students!"
As soon as these words came out.
Cao Aman, who was pinned to the ground by two Jinyi guards and unable to move, couldn't help laughing and said:
"Master Xu, have you found any evidence that I assassinated His Majesty?"
"If not, I advise you to think about it quickly and explain your frame-up behavior to us scholars later!"
Hearing Cao Aman's extremely arrogant words, Xu Da's face became extremely gloomy.
Especially when he saw Shen Lang strolling around there unhurriedly, he became even more angry.
With a cold face, he walked up to Shen Lang and asked, "I told you, boy, are you trustworthy or not?!"
"Master Li is coming soon, why are you still here counting koi?"
Faced with Xu Da's questioning, Shen Lang, who had been thinking about whether to find out where Cao A's hidden treasure was hidden, also went all out and said:
"Sir, I would like to ask this humble question, is your relationship with my wife or the Shangguan family strong enough?"
Xu Da raised his eyebrows: "Why do you ask this?"
"It's nothing, I just want to earn some medical expenses for my mother-in-law, and I'm worried that you might have objections, sir!" Shen Lang scratched his head honestly.
"Oh?"
As a veteran of the two dynasties, Xu Da can be said to be an elite person in the officialdom.
Hearing Shen Lang's words, he understood instantly.
Shen Lang hasn't been working, it's not because he is unreliable.
But he really wants to be corrupt!
To be honest, if any of his subordinates had planned to commit embezzlement during a house raid in the past and mentioned it in front of him, he would definitely have them killed as a warning to others!
But now, he already knows the relationship between Shen Lang and Shen Xiao.
He also knew that Shen Lang was embezzling in order to treat Shen Xiao, so he would not refuse.
